A separate LabVIEW application, named BarTarget, is then used post-test to analyze the acquired video stills to generate a contrast ratio value of selected regions of interest. The contrast ratio Page 2 of 8 values are then manually plotted by the user in Microsoft Excel and compared to known Haze Standard values. This Call for Solution aims to develop an improved BarTarget application that can be designed to analyze post-test acquired video images from both cameras and generate the contrast ratio value per selected region of interest and plot the contrast ratio over the duration time of the test and output a result per designated pass/fail criteria based upon the haze calibration measurements. 2. PROBLEM STATEMENT DEVCOM-SC OEMB is seeking innovative solutions to: (1) Develop a post-test image analysis sub-program for use with Soldier Center-developed Fog Tester instrument control and data acquisition software. This sub-program will replace the current BarTarget program, and the data plotting performed in Microsoft Excel by the user. (2) Deliver a sub-program which shall also be able to process calibration tests, analyze the data and deliver a calibrations ﬁle for input to the pass/fail criteria. 3. DESIRED SOLUTION OBJECTIVES T

Should the one-time software license and the 15-week implementation be priced inside Base Year CLIN 0001, or does the Government prefer a separate line item for license and implementation? A: Please annotate the costs as separate line items in the Base Year costs Q: The Product Service Code is 7A20 (perpetual license software), while the CLIN titles reference annual support and maintenance.
